analyst_view.overall: Early view: Sint-Truiden are unbeaten in the league phase (2-0 Iberia, 1-0 at Midtjylland, 1-1 Brann) and have conceded once. Ajax lost at Hajduk on the first night but then beat Atalanta 2-0 and won 6-1 at Midtjylland, with Tolu Arokodare scoring twice. Little recent Sint-Truiden news was found, so their side of this view rests on results.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.4 goals. Ajax are scoring freely under Michel, but Sint-Truiden have let in one goal in three games; those cancel out, so I stay with the estimate.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.6 corners. Nothing in the news points either way, so I stay with it.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.5 cards. The referee is not known and there is no history between the sides, so I stay with the estimate.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.3 shots, with Ajax on only 12. I lean a little higher: Ajax created a lot in their last two European games and now have Arokodare, Oscar Gloukh and Marcos Leonardo all scoring, which should lift their share. They were without Sofyan Amrabat and Julian Brandt at Midtjylland, and Kasper Dolberg hurt his knee in October.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.0 shots on target. Ajax's finishing has been sharp, but Sint-Truiden have kept things tight, so I stay with the estimate.
